engineeringQa.semantics: Engineering QA and native crash injection are build-only capabilities allowed exclusively for the explicit internal APP_ENV allowlist. Missing, unknown, publicdev, preview, and production environments fail closed, and engineering QA never constitutes legal/product release approval.

deviceEvidence.semantics: Schema v2 accepts only run-scoped semantic reports bound to an authority-signed capture inventory and a signed build identity extracted from the retained IPA/APK, plus the loaded-app nonce/build evidence id, canonical source/dependency closure, and gate-specific technical packaging attestations. The repository registers only QA public keys; private capture keys remain outside source with restricted permissions. Android release readiness additionally requires a separate independently signed approval record.

linkCompatibility.reason: Ghostty Wuffs 0.4 and React Native Skia Wuffs 0.3 export overlapping unversioned symbols; isolate Ghostty's private copy before the final app link.

directGhosttyBuild.requiredAction: Open and complete a separate pinned direct-source build packet before using this path.

fallbackUpstream.name: ghostty
fallbackUpstream.useWhen: Candidate upstream for a separate future direct-source-build packet if libghostty-spm becomes stale, divergent, unavailable, or release-blocking

notes: Selected iOS v1 substrate for the GhosttyKit XCFramework artifact and libghostty C module bridge.
GhosttyTerminal Swift sources are an API/lifecycle reference unless Happier explicitly vendors/builds that source target later.
Must be pinned by exact revision/version and checksum before production bundling.
Patch/source provenance, license/NOTICE, size, ABI smoke, App Store/export, and update/rollback procedure are release gates.
Vendors GhosttyKit.xcframework directly in an iOS Xcode project.
Wraps the Ghostty C surface API from Swift for runtime/app/surface lifecycle, byte feed, write callback, resize, draw, selection, text extraction, and clipboard.
Use as lifecycle/API reference only; do not make Remodex a production binary supply-chain dependency.

forbiddenModules.name: app
forbiddenModules.reason: The full Termux app is GPL-3.0-only and is out of scope for the native renderer package.

forbiddenModules.name: termux-shared
forbiddenModules.reason: TERM-6 only approves terminal-view and terminal-emulator until dependency closure review says otherwise.

remoteSessionAdapter.reason: Termux TerminalSession/TerminalView are process-backed; Happier adapts TerminalEmulator and TerminalRenderer to the remote daemon byte stream without spawning a local Android shell.

approvalBoundary.engineeringPolicyVerification: The extractor and Gradle checks verify the exact pinned revision, terminal-only module closure, copied upstream license, and forbidden-module absence.
approvalBoundary.environmentGateSemantics: HAPPIER_TERMINAL_NATIVE_ANDROID_LEGAL_ACCEPTED is a release-owner assertion only; setting it does not create or replace legal advice or product approval evidence.
approvalBoundary.releaseApprovalEvidence: Must be recorded outside this machine-readable source-closure policy by the authorized product/legal release owners against the exact pinned revision.
